heading: Working capital fund; availability for common personnel support services
lead: The Working Capital Fund of the Department of Health and Human Services shall on and after August 10, 1971, be available for expenses necessary for common personnel support services in the Washington area.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was enacted as part of title II of Pub. L. 92–80, popularly known as the Department of Health, Education, and Welfare Appropriation Act, 1972. Section was formerly classified to section 905a of this title.

notes.heading: Change of Name
notes.text: “Department of Health and Human Services” substituted in text for “Department of Health, Education, and Welfare” pursuant to section 509(b) of Pub. L. 96–88, which is classified to section 3508(b) of Title 20, Education.

ancestors.heading: DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES
